links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT answers to cervical and breast cancer questions
links.effect: Readability was comparable to experts and physicians, but ChatGPT responses were longer than physicians' and readability was judged inadequate.
links.quote: However, there were apparent inconsistencies, and the reliability and readability be considered inadequate.

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT answers across repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: Consistency of repeated answers was 5.2 on a 7-point scale (range 3.4-6.7); the authors noted apparent inconsistencies.
links.quote: The consistency of repeated answers was 5.2 (range: 3.4-6.7).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing ChatGPT responses to physician responses on frequently asked questions about breast and cervical cancer, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
